question: The Third Battle of Panipat was fought between _____.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Marathas and Afghans.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Third Battle of Panipat** was fought between the **Marathas and Afghans** on** January 14, 1761. **
 
• The Maratha army was led by** Sadashivrao Bhau** while the Afghan forces were led by **Ahmad Shah Durrani.**
 
• The battle was one of the** largest and bloodies**t fought in the **18th century**, with estimates of casualties ranging from** 60,000 to 100,000.**
 
• The Marathas suffered a **crushing defeat** in the battle, leading to the **decline of their power** and the **rise of British influence** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Mughal Empire** had already **declined** by the time of the Third Battle of Panipat and did not play a significant role in the conflict.
 
• The **Turks** were **not** involved in the battle, as it was fought between the** Marathas and Afghans.**
 
• The **Mughals** were not involved in the battle, as they had** lost much of their power by the 18th century** and were not a major military force in India.
